raceCraft.officialRule: Ski Erg is done individually (not simultaneous) in doubles — one partner works while the other rests/transitions. Standard is 1000m per team.
raceCraft.transitionTip: Don't sprint into the handle change — a clean, unrushed grip swap saves more time than a frantic one. Step off cleanly to the side so you don't block your partner's approach.
raceCraft.handoffStrategy: Split by strength: whoever has the stronger pull does a bigger share (e.g. 600m/400m split) rather than forcing an even 500/500 if one of you is clearly faster on the erg.

days.title: Hyrox Station Training
days.details: Hyrox station session @ ATC. Sled PUSH: 6 x 25m @ race-effort load, 2 min rest between reps. Sled PULL: 5 x 25m, sustained pull, no stopping mid-rep. Ski Erg: 4 x 500m @ hard (race effort), 2 min rest between reps. Lunges: 100m walking lunge (Hyrox distance) for time, 2 sets, rest 2 min. Burpees: 3 x 15 broad-jump burpees (race-style), 90s rest. Finish with: 3 x 8 Romanian deadlifts + farmer's carry 3 x 40m heavy dumbbells + 2 x 10 goblet squats.

raceCraft.officialRule: Sled must be pushed the full distance (women's doubles: typically 2x50m lengths per partner-shared total) with hands on the sled the whole time — no-rep if you let go or run alongside without contact.
raceCraft.transitionTip: Low, choppy steps beat big lunging strides — a fallen or stalled sled costs way more time than a slightly slower steady push.
raceCraft.handoffStrategy: Whoever's stronger on the push should take the heavier first length while legs are fresh; swap at the turnaround, not mid-length.

raceCraft.officialRule: Sled must be pushed the full distance (women's doubles: typically 2x50m lengths per partner-shared total) with hands on the sled the whole time — no-rep if you let go or run alongside without contact.
raceCraft.transitionTip: Low, choppy steps beat big lunging strides — a fallen or stalled sled costs way more time than a slightly slower steady push.
raceCraft.handoffStrategy: Whoever's stronger on the push should take the heavier first length while legs are fresh; swap at the turnaround, not mid-length.
